description: Scheduled macroeconomic data releases (CPI, FOMC, jobs, GDP, etc.) from the last ~2 days through the next 7 days. Optionally set 'min_importance' (1-3, default 2) to filter out low-impact releases.

min_importance.description: Minimum importance level to include: 1 (all), 2 (medium+), 3 (high only). Defaults to 2.

name: catalysts_economic_calendar

events.description: Releases at or above the requested importance, up to 40; empty when none

actual.description: Published value, in the release's own unit; absent until released

forecast.description: Consensus forecast, in the release's own unit; absent when none

previous.description: Previous value, in the release's own unit; absent when none

releaseMs.description: Scheduled release time, epoch ms; absent when TBD

title: Economic Calendar
